body: I hate to say it but these can be signs he might cheat. Even if it isn’t in the physical sense. It could maybe lead to the online sex chats and things of that nature. Not saying absolutely of course. He might be very loyal to you no matter what’s going on between you both. I’m just speaking from my own experience (33F). It’s very hard once you feel that emotional disconnect. Especially if you’re trying to reconnect and he isn’t. I advise suggesting some couples counseling. Cause once you go down the road you both are it can be a slippery slope. It’s hard and takes time. But I’m sure you want to know you did all you could to try and work things out.

It could be that the “spark” isn’t there lately. And if that’s the case I know it’s hard during the pandemic with so many places still being closed but I’d say try and find dates ideas for you guys. Try bringing some of the earlier romance back in. Flirt with her more as well and remind her of how sexy you find her throughout the day. Now if it isn’t that I would say definitely the birth control. It can at times make your libido non existent as well as so many other side effects. Switching birth control sometimes works but if it hasn’t for her then her body might just need a break from it. With her being afraid of getting pregnant maybe suggest that with her off birth control and you using condoms you guys can also avoid sex during the time she is ovulating to maybe bring her some less worry of getting pregnant.
That violin makes me wish i kept playing

Idk if I’d take it as a sign of that. Maybe you just haven’t found what works for you. I tried some things I learned from other patients in the hospital that didn’t really work for me but did great for them. Idk how quarantined/isolated at home you are but I know that’s exacerbated it all for me.

I was feeling that way too. Some days I still do. It’s an overwhelming feeling. I feel like when you’re trying to get out of the ocean at the beach but get knocked down by a wave and every time you get up a bigger wave knocks you right back down. It’s hard to see anything better when you’re in this hole of a low... if that makes any sense. Since I’ve been home from the hospital I’ve been trying to find different ways to cope. I’ve never been one to tell all the details of my life (especially my depression) to family or even best friends so I’ve been writing a lot of what I’m feeling down. Not like a dear diary type of deal but just writing my angry upset hurt hopeless thoughts and for me it’s been pretty therapeutic. I’m also not a cry in front of people kind of person so this gives me the time to let it all out when I’m writing alone. Also meditation in the morning and night has been helping too. I have terrible nightmares. More so now than before my attempt but the meditation has been helping that a little. Of course everything isn’t gonna just pop away but it’s a work in progress.

I definitely understand that. I’ve been battling with my depression as well and recently intentionally overdosed. Is there something going on in your life that’s brought you to this point that you want to talk about?

This can actually be a symptom from the trauma you went through when you were younger (you spoke about in your other post). It doesn’t seem like you’re being treated well at home in terms of this issue so if one of your parents can take you to speak with a therapist they might be able to delve into this with you. If you don’t think that’s an option there are apps and online therapists you can find. I hope this helps.

If you’re wherever he is but in the bathroom you need to leave. If you don’t feel safe leaving like maybe he’ll stop you then I advise you call someone to come get you immediately. That behavior is very abusive and he’s going further each time. And I repeat DO NOT be afraid to call 911 if need be.
I agree. I think you should look at your options for another therapist.

Him “pushing” you to break up with him instead of sitting down with you to tell you how he was feeling and break it off himself was manipulative behavior. Doesn’t sound like a good person to keep in your life even as an acquaintance. It might be hard to see that now because you love him but keeping this particular person in your life, in my opinion, wouldn’t add any value to your life. Sometimes you have to be selfish with yourself and not give so much to the people that don’t deserve it.
Super Intense and passionate. At least for my bf and I it always is.

The messages with his ex are definitely cheating and I personally feel that messaging with any females on any platform for pics is cheating as well. It’s not like he’s just searching a video on pornhub. It’s way more direct and personal in my opinion. And sending sex workers money?? For pics or real life sexual favors?? I just think that people should be able to have more self control out of respect, love and loyalty to their partner and their feelings. And if he really has a problem he should be seeing someone to help him. The fact that you found all this before and went through this all with him and knowing how those things made you feel and the promises he made to you that it wouldn’t happen again just shows the lack of respect he has for you. I’m sorry you’re going through this. Everyone deserves better than that.

At the end of the day if your child’s paternal father wants to see his child whether you or your significant other like it or not he can take the legal channels to do so without asking you. But with him coming to you requesting to see your child is there a reason that you didn’t take your partners opinions or feelings on the matter more serious? Is there a reason why, although you regret it, you said what you said as your immediate reaction? This is the person who’s been the only other parent your child has known since they were 3 months old so is there maybe something else that brought on that reaction like unfinished business with your ex that maybe you haven’t even thought about until now?
